answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 48490 Country: Bangladesh Title: Topi Question: Is wearing topi all the time a sunnah? Some say that it is a regular sunnah. Please help me with your precious opinion. Answer ID: 48490 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1494/1153/B=11/1434) One should wear the cap / topi every time except sleeping and bathing. It is against the dignity to remain without topi. Cap has always been the cloth of esteemed people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
